title: Core and satellite: give every fund a job
objectives: Build a core-satellite structure with illustrative shares.
Say the test for keeping a fund: a clear, different job.
body_md:
Build around core and satellite. Core: broad, steady exposure; 1–2 flexi-cap, large-cap or index funds; typically 60–80% of equity. Satellite: extra growth or a different style; 1–3 mid-cap, small-cap, value or international funds; typically 20–40% of equity. Each fund should have a clear, different job. If two funds do the same job, keep the better one. Shares above are illustrative and depend on the risk profile.

| Part | Role | Typical funds | Typical share of equity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Core | Broad, steady exposure | 1–2 flexi-cap, large-cap or index funds | 60–80% |
| Satellite | Extra growth or a different style | 1–3 mid-cap, small-cap, value or international funds | 20–40% |
example: Core: 1 index fund + 1 flexi-cap fund (70%). Satellites: 1 mid-cap + 1 small-cap (30%) — four funds, four jobs.
say: Each fund should have a clear, different job.
If two funds do the same job, keep the better one.
never: Every fund needs the same job.
